subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “No one has to explain why they need food.”?
options: Entertainment can open the door to history, but careful reading must walk through it.
Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.
They simply open the door and take what they need.
A minute cannot finish everything, but it can open the door.
